newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Indonesia Bank BII allots US$35 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Bank BII allots US$35 mln FRCD.

text.p: PT Bank Internasional Indonesia's US$35 million floating rate certificates of deposit issue has closed, arranger HSBC Markets said on Monday.
The five-year issue, which was launched through the bank's Cayman Islands branch, was issued at par to float at 85 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 109 basis points.
Arranger HSBC Markets committed US$12 million.
Co-lead managers are Paine Webber International (UK), with US$10 million, and Standard Chartered Bank, with US$4 million.

Co-managers are First Commercial Bank's Singapore branch, with US$3 million, and Credito Italiano's Singapore branch, Emirates bank International and Grand Commercial Bank's Offshore Banking branch, with US$2 million each.
Signing is tentatively set for March 26. The payment date is tentatively set on April 11.
